stem.text: Two nuclides are different isotopes of the same element.
Which statement about the nuclides is correct?

A.text: Neutral atoms of the nuclides have the same number of electrons.

B.text: Nuclei of the nuclides have different numbers of protons.

C.text: Nuclei of the nuclides have the same number of nucleons.

D.text: Nuclei of the nuclides have the same number of neutrons.
